ledger-conflicting-repeat.source_review_basis: Two matching button anchors have different immediate successors: River and Hill.

ledger-consistent-repeat.source_review_basis: Every matching Release button has the same observed successor River; repetition alone does not imply ambiguity.

ledger-named-scope-repeat.source_review_basis: The question names Footer; Header is a separate scope and cannot supply a competing answer.

ledger-opaque-intervening.source_review_basis: An intervening group has omitted children. The source does not establish which interactive action is next; it is unsafe to skip the group.

ledger-clipped-repeat.source_review_basis: The first anchor is followed by River, but the second matching anchor is followed by a clipped action label. The answer cannot be uniquely established.
